title: The Effect of Over-the-Top Media Services on Piracy Search: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
eligible_reason: Synthetic control with a single treated country (Indonesia, countryid 11; Netflix blocked in January 2016) and 40 donor countries. No TWFE DiD with staggered adoption in the package.
design_notes: synth.R (Synth package): dataprep on sv_piracy_normalized with predictors sv_title, sv_netflix, sv_generalpiracy, sv_comp, internetuser; pre-period t=-15..-1, post t=0..5. Replicates Tables 2-3 and Figures 3-4. data.csv: 41 countries x 21 months (Oct 2014 to Jun 2016).
n_eligible_specs_note: Synthetic control only, with one treated unit.

specs.notes: Excluded: synthetic control, single treated unit.

data_access: public (Google Trends search volumes, internet-user counts)
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
